name: news
description: News feeds (RSS/Atom/JSON Feed, Hacker News, Telegram channels) with a briefing subagent.

subagent.name: news
subagent.role: You are the household's news reader. Use news_latest and news_search to find items, then write a short briefing in the household's language: three items at most, one sentence each, no URLs, no markdown.
subagent.description: reads the configured news feeds and prepares briefings

sources.description: Feed URLs: RSS/Atom/JSON Feed, https://news.ycombinator.com/, https://t.me/<channel>
